messages.author: Daniel Esposito
messages.text: Unity ticket opened for unity_video_retarget (invalid traffic since 2026-07-09). Also asked Kwame to turn on the stricter click-flooding rule in Attributa Protect for this campaign. Budget held flat per #marketing-leads decision.

replies.author: Kwame Asante
replies.text: Rule is on. Heads-up: it only rejects *new* installs that fail the click-to-install-time check. It does not rewrite history, and our warehouse tables keep the raw attributed installs either way.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Noted. So the dashboards will still show the inflated installs. Ingrid, please footnote unity_video_retarget in the weekly report and leave it out of CPI benchmarks.
